status: ARCHITECTURE ONLY — preregistered before the R1 diagnostic comparison · NOT implemented · no runtime V3

prominence_predicate.name: PROMINENT(system)
prominence_predicate.nature: deterministic categorical predicate over governed atomic facts of that system — one system at a time; never compares systems; never sums
CONSTRUCTION: axis-neutral primitive instance on a constitutive construction referent (collar/lapel · closure/placket · cuff · pocket system · shoulder · waist construction): relative_size = large ∨ contrast = high  [REQUIRES SCOPE AMENDMENT SA-1]

DM designed-detail evidence whose source_observation_refs name a construction parameter (collar · closure_type · cuff_type · pocket · attachment) with relative_size = large ∨ contrast = high  [REQUIRES CONSUMPTION AMENDMENT SA-2]
MATERIAL_SURFACE: DM evidence family surface_pattern / surface_treatment with relative_size = large ∨ spatial_position = whole_garment  [SA-2]
surface / material value with coverage = Dominant (coverage read as Derived from size + position when the triple exists; the stored adjudicated coverage token is admissible as the same fact)
DECORATION: DM evidence family graphic / attached_detail / attached_hardware / decorative_construction / designed_color_contrast with relative_size = large ∨ spatial_position ∈ {distributed, whole_garment}  [SA-2]
decorative_detail / attachment value with coverage ∈ {Partial, Dominant}
prominence_predicate.UNKNOWN: any required fact NOT_VISIBLE / UNKNOWN, or the system's prominence fact not governed for its referent (today: structural construction apparatus without SA-1) → UNKNOWN
excluded_inputs: any SR / DM / EI axis output

classic_organising_role.owner: D-7 Classic evaluator (TC semantic runtime successor)
classic_organising_role.precondition: D7-S1 (1) reference authored ∧ (2) construction realization CHARACTERISTIC
relation: MOST_PROMINENT iff PROMINENT(CONSTRUCTION) ∧ ¬PROMINENT(BODY_FORM) ∧ ¬PROMINENT(MATERIAL_SURFACE) ∧ ¬PROMINENT(DECORATION) — OR ¬PROMINENT for every system while the characteristic system is realised CHARACTERISTIC and every competitor prominence fact is OBSERVED-absent (the plain-tailored case: construction is the only structured system)
ANOTHER_SYSTEM_MORE_PROMINENT iff ¬PROMINENT(CONSTRUCTION) ∧ exactly one other system PROMINENT
UNDETERMINED otherwise: any UNKNOWN among the four, or two or more PROMINENT systems (tie), or ¬PROMINENT(CONSTRUCTION) with two or more PROMINENT competitors
classic_organising_role.completeness: all four prominence predicates must be evaluable (no UNKNOWN); the requiredness gate of the DM block (evidence: [] = observed, nothing admitted) is what makes competitor absence an observation rather than a missing answer
classic_organising_role.output: D7-S1 step (3): MOST_PROMINENT → MATERIAL · ANOTHER_SYSTEM_MORE_PROMINENT → INCIDENTAL · UNDETERMINED → UNRESOLVED / ITEM_OBSERVATION_RESOLUTION_GAP
classic_organising_role.provenance: per-system predicate result + the governed facts (parameter · value · state · source) + rule id

transformative_organising_reading.precondition: V1 precedence P1–P6 passed; constitutive_system_status computed (unchanged)
transformative_organising_reading.referent: BODY_FORM for Silhouette / Proportion Statements; the departure-locus construction system for Construction Statements
relation: MOST_PROMINENT iff PROMINENT(referent) ∧ no other system PROMINENT
NOT iff ¬PROMINENT(referent) ∧ all four predicates evaluable
transformative_organising_reading.output: S3 alignment (MOST_PROMINENT) · S4 non-alignment (NOT) · S1-equivalent UNRESOLVED (UNDETERMINED)

tie_rule: none preregistered — two PROMINENT systems → UNDETERMINED (fail-closed). A tie rule, if ever wanted, is a CEO semantic decision, not an observation.
